exact.颜色来自月面反射率（反照率）：亮色多为古老高地与年轻环形山的辐射纹，暗色为后期玄: Colour comes from surface reflectance (albedo): bright areas are mostly ancient highlands and the ray systems of young craters, dark areas are maria flooded by later basaltic lava. The maria cluster on the near side while the far side is cratered highland — that near–far asymmetry is itself part of the Moon's story.
